prerequisites: Basic programming and computer science knowledge

learning_outcomes.text: Students know current methods and procedures for the protection of IT systems and networks.
Students understand the function and limits of current security technologies. They know organizational measures for planning and operating corresponding technical protection measures.
Students know how technical security measures work and have understood why associated organizational measures and processes are necessary.
Students can identify solutions for IT security-relevant problems and are able to roughly conceptualize solutions independently.
Students can implement specific technical security measures (VPN, Firewall).

syllabus_topics: Firewall techniques, firewall systems, Intrusion Detection and Prevention
Emergency preparedness and Business Continuity Management
Organization of IT security and security management
Security concepts and IT basic protection
assessment_rules: The graded examination is a written examination. The ungraded examination is an experimental work consisting of approximately 6 experiments. The type of examination is chosen by the lecturer. Examination duration and scope are defined by the current study regulations for the written examination.
bibliography: Claudia Eckert, "IT-Sicherheit: Konzepte, Verfahren, Protokolle", De Gruyter
W.Stallings: "Sicherheit im Internet - Cryptography and network security", Pearson
Stefan Wendzel, "IT-Sicherheit für TCP/IP- und IoT-Netzwerke", Springer Vieweg
